text: The perspective is wrong in a way that feels correct — lines converge toward a far shore whose name no one can pronounce, guided only by trust that the crossing itself is the destination. Pocket watches melt over the edge of a table and over a sleeping face that is also a cliff. Pocket watches melt over the branch of a dead tree, over the edge of a dead tree, over the edge of a table and over a sleeping face that, looked at again, is a tree. An unhurried, courteous carriage pulls up unannounced, and a woman, a woman, a river of raspberry juice, a doorway and a vase.
